tickerText: [TENNIS] Halloween Saturday semifinals at the indoor ATP 500s: Vienna sees Daniil Medvedev face Carlos Alcaraz before Alexander Zverev meets Alex de Minaur for two final spots, while Basel pits Valentin Vacherot against Taylor Fritz and Jiří Lehečka against Jan-Lennard Struff • [SQUASH] Weekend action across the PSA calendar includes the Czech Open in Brno, North Coast Open in Coffs Harbour and Moscow Squash Open satellite play as Toronto's Canadian Women's Open and Smart Centres Canada Cup wrap their Silver events • [BADMINTON] HYLO Open semifinal Saturday in Saarbrücken: Lakshya Sen meets Toma Junior Popov and Jonatan Christie faces Anders Antonsen in men's singles, while P. V. Sindhu and Anmol Kharb clash in an all-Indian women's semifinal after Malaysian pairs Hoo/Lai and Aaron Tai/Yap Roy King reached the last four • [PICKLEBALL] Farmers Branch hosts Halloween Nations Cup pool play at Brookhaven Country Club alongside Senior Open and pro qualifying at the College World Championship before the Opendoor PPA major main draw opens Monday • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier quarterfinal day at Sud de France Arena: Felix Lebrun and Hugo Calderano headline the men's draw with Lin Shidong vs Truls Möregårdh and Patrick Franziska vs Zhou Qihao, while Sun Yingsha, Wang Yidi and Hina Hayata lead the women's last eight

newsItems.title: Vienna & Basel Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Medvedev–Alcaraz and Zverev–de Minaur set Vienna's finalists; Vacherot–Fritz and Lehečka–Struff decide Basel on Halloween Saturday.

newsItems.title: Hylo Semifinal Day
newsItems.excerpt: Sindhu vs Kharb headlines an all-Indian women's semifinal in Saarbrücken as Sen and Christie chase men's final spots at the Super 500.

newsItems.title: Nations Cup Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: Halloween pool play continues at Brookhaven as the MLP Nations Cup and College World Championship qualifying share Farmers Branch.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Quarters
newsItems.excerpt: Lebrun and Calderano lead men's quarterfinals at Sud de France Arena as Sun Yingsha, Wang Yidi and Hayata head the women's last eight.
